guarantees.rtdb-landing-writer-control-round-trip: RTDB decodes the original typed writer row as a check-only operation with its supplied expectation.
guarantees.rtdb-landing-group-lengths-round-trip: RTDB decodes the sender’s group and relation lengths and the Arrow stream length in their original widths and byte order.
guarantees.rtdb-landing-marker-fingerprint-round-tr: RTDB decodes the submitted fingerprint and unmodified suffix from a cursor at the reserved slot.
guarantees.rtdb-landing-held-revision-round-trip: RTDB emits the supplied row revision under the exact held-result metadata key.
guarantees.rtdb-landing-writer-predecessor-stamp: The shipped ordered writer comparison requires the predecessor’s exact submitted stamp.
guarantees.rtdb-landing-staging-writer-bound: An admitted staging clock follows its sample strictly before the bound and does not replace the exact writer comparison.
guarantees.rtdb-landing-refusal-original-writer: The shipped refusal decision retains and compares the original primary writer check.
guarantees.rtdb-landing-prepared-action-slot: A kind-six landing must use the prepared switch action and its offered clock slot.
guarantees.rtdb-landing-marker-event-revision: The shipped marker construction preserves the submitted fingerprint and staged events require the original assigned revision.
guarantees.rtdb-landing-refusal-marker-fingerprint: A selected paired refusal marker has exactly the submitted marker fingerprint.
guarantees.rtdb-landing-publication-advances-claim: An admitted placed action follows both coordinates of a reopened claim covered by its predecessor and compares the observed claim stamp exactly.
guarantees.rtdb-landing-chosen-predecessor-model: An accepted action in the RTDB ordered model compared its expected stamp with the modeled predecessor authority.
guarantees.rtdb-landing-prepared-action-model: The RTDB ordered model excludes kind-six ordinary actions and prepared switches without a clock slot.
guarantees.rtdb-landing-complete-context-markers-mo: The RTDB ordered model records the exact submitted fingerprint and revision for every context in an accepted action.
guarantees.rtdb-landing-same-installation-reopen-mo: The RTDB ordered model preserves the selected recovered prefix and uses the exact claim stamp on a later action over that same modeled history.
guarantees.rtdb-landing-prepared-switch-basis: RTDB's installed switch checks the prepared transaction predecessor, block, storage version and epoch, replica epoch and prefix, and both coordinates of the assigned transaction key before either prepared decision can be selected.
guarantees.rtdb-staged-archive-transaction: An accepted stage comparison uses the original manifest digest and a nonnegative recovered transaction ID whose checkpoint timestamp and ID match the supplied snapshot basis.
guarantees.rtdb-staged-archive-object: The sealed object identity decision accepts exactly the supplied manifest name, length and digest. Cryptographic identity and transport are supplied by the archive provider.
guarantees.rtdb-staged-archive-trie-cursor: Within the selected trie vector, the cursor returns the entry at its current index and advances inside the bounds. It is empty exactly at the vector end.
guarantees.rtdb-held-watch-next-publication: RTDB's held merged-journal reader chooses the earliest eligible physical position from the supplied journal heads. The same decision certifies quiet completion only when no eligible head remains.
guarantees.rtdb-held-watch-exact-fragment: RTDB's held merged-journal reader requires the decoded header and stored fragment to carry the exact selected publication and a positive event count continuing the preceding frontier.
